featured_reviews.name: MOHAMMED IBRAHIM GIRNI
featured_reviews.review_text:
✨ EPIC & HISTORIC TRIBUTE ✨
Celebrating 100 Years of Maganlal Dresswala – Juhu Scheme, Near Kala Niketan

Established in 1926, Maganlal Dresswala has stood tall for a century, surviving and thriving across three generations. From the pioneering days when they became the first to rent costumes to the entire cast of the first-ever Bollywood movie, to today’s vibrant cultural celebrations, their journey is nothing short of legendary.

At the helm of this legacy is the dynamic and charming Ms. Sarika Punjabi, whose agility, resilience, and professionalism have kept this family business alive and flourishing. Her patience and passion shine through in every detail – even in managing the moods, mischief, and tantrums of children with grace and warmth.

🌸 My First Visit – A Republic Day Surprise 🌸

On 26th January 2026, during our Republic Day celebrations, the children of our society staged a surprise dance performance to the timeless song:
“Madhuban mein jo Kanhaiya kisi gopi se mile…”

Clad in the traditional costumes provided by Maganlal Dresswala, the children transformed the atmosphere into one of pomp, gaiety, and glittering festivity.

- Their white turbans, kurta& Dhoti pyjamas, vests, and red waistbands radiated purity and tradition along with colorful and shimmering ghagra choli for little girls.

- The colorful balloons and festive backdrop amplified the joy of the occasion.

- The children’s innocent smiles and graceful dance moves brought alive the moods of devotion, celebration, and unity.

It was a spectacle where heritage met modern festivity, and the costumes became the bridge between tradition and performance.

🌟 Legacy That Inspires 🌟

Maganlal Dresswala is not just a costume house – it is a living institution of Indian cinema and culture. For 100 years, they have:

- Preserved the art of costume-making.

- Empowered generations of performers.

- Brought authenticity, elegance, and grandeur to countless stages and screens.

Their centenary year is a reminder that tradition, when nurtured with resilience and innovation, becomes timeless.

🙏 Our Heartfelt Wishes 🙏

On behalf of our society and the children who danced with joy in their costumes, we extend our warmest wishes to Maganlal Dresswala:

➡️ May your journey continue to inspire.
➡️ May your legacy shine brighter with each passing year.
➡️ May your artistry keep weaving magic into India’s cultural fabric.

Here’s to another century of costumes, culture, and celebration! 🎉

1. Variety - u name it and they would most likely have it
2. Hygiene - the biggest barrier in my mind about rented costumes is hygiene but I was pleasantly surprised with the cleanliness and maintenance of the costumes
3. Quality of costume - the costume that you will get here is really good quality and would not look cheap
4. Full attire vs just a make shift arrangement - again something interesting was that they would give u everything including accessories with the costumes!
5. The service was very good! In fact return was smoother and faster than I anticipated with full refund given in minutes!

One thing to be mindful is that it is not a cheap place unlike a lot of other options but given the quality, hygiene, service, etc… I’d say it is worth it!
